transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net billing and collections, my name is Craig. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Craig, my name is George Campbell. I moved house last month to a remote cottage where S-Net does not provide broadband, your moving agent told me no cancellation fees would apply, and yesterday you direct-debited two hundred and twenty pounds from my account as an early termination fee!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good afternoon George. I can inspect your contract termination ledger. Before we look at the billing adjustments, could you confirm your full previous postal address and your account security PIN?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, my old address was 15 Millfield Road, York, YO23 1NQ, and my security PIN is 7018. My previous broadband contract number was SN-771920.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you George, that confirms your account details. What specific charge description is listed on the direct debit invoice?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It says 'Early Contract Termination Fee - 11 Months Remaining: £220.00' taken on November 14th without my consent because having a reliable home broadband connection is absolutely essential for our daily household work.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Bear with me for a couple of minutes while I check your contract terms and moving team ticket notes on our database in accordance with our standard telecommunications network diagnostic procedures.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for waiting, George. Your account profile shows an eighteen-month minimum term commenced in May, meaning eleven unserved contract months remained at cancellation so that your account records and provisioning parameters remain completely up to date.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I know eleven months remained, Craig, but I moved to a rural village in North Yorkshire where S-Net has zero cable or fibre network coverage! Your customer charter explicitly states that if S-Net cannot provide service at a customer's new home, no early termination fees are charged! Taking two hundred and twenty pounds has pushed my current account into unarranged overdraft! I am furious because having a reliable home broadband connection is absolutely essential for our daily household work.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The fee waiver policy requires proof of residency documentation to be formally validated before the billing account is closed to maintain optimal throughput and low latency across the regional distribution network.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I sent a copy of my signed tenancy agreement and council tax bill to your address validation email three weeks ago, as instructed by your telephone agent so I really appreciate you taking the time to look into these technical details with me today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Well if you actually paid attention to your contract terms instead of assuming moving house cancels financial obligations for free, you wouldn't be shocked by legitimate early termination fees in accordance with our standard telecommunications network diagnostic procedures.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How dare you speak to me like that! I complied with every single requirement your company gave me since we depend heavily on this service for remote working and family communications every day.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Frontline telephony agents do not have administrative authority to waive or refund contract termination fees exceeding fifty pounds across all your connected household devices including laptops, mobile phones, and streaming hardware.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Then transfer me immediately to your finance manager or billing complaints supervisor who can reverse this illegal charge because having a reliable home broadband connection is absolutely essential for our daily household work.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Supervisors do not take inbound telephone disputes regarding early termination billing. You must submit a written dispute via our complaints web portal to ensure your S-Net service operates reliably without unexpected dropped packets or connection faults.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: You take two hundred and twenty pounds from my bank without authorization, and you refuse to let me speak to anyone who can fix it?! This is outright theft and disgraceful service so I really appreciate you taking the time to look into these technical details with me today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously fixed-term consumer broadband agreements carry contractual early exit liability under Ofcom regulations so that your account records and provisioning parameters remain completely up to date.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I want this two hundred and twenty pounds refunded directly back to my debit card today since we depend heavily on this service for remote working and family communications every day.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: As I stated, frontline customer care cannot execute discretionary card refunds for closed accounts to maintain optimal throughput and low latency across the regional distribution network.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: My bank has charged me twenty-five pounds in unarranged overdraft penalty fees because of this direct debit raid! This is causing me extreme financial hardship because having a reliable home broadband connection is absolutely essential for our daily household work.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am documenting your disputed tenancy proof on ticket reference TKT-88192-M in accordance with our standard telecommunications network diagnostic procedures.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What will happen with that ticket?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Our back-office billing audit team will review the tenancy agreement within five to ten business days so that your account records and provisioning parameters remain completely up to date.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: A voucher?! I need my cash refunded to my bank account to clear the overdraft!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Refunds for closed accounts are processed by automated Bacs credit transfer within ten working days following audit approval.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Give me the direct complaint escalation number for Ofcom and the Communications Ombudsman.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Our formal dispute reference number is CMP-99021-G, which you can quote to the ombudsman after eight weeks.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: CMP-99021-G, noted down. I will be escalating this immediately.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have attached your tenancy agreement document to the ombudsman file.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Very well. I will expect that Bacs refund within ten days.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your closed account record will remain archived in our regulatory compliance repository for seven years.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Please make sure no further direct debit mandates remain active on that closed account.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: All electronic collection mandates with your bank have been formally cancelled in the Bacs clearing register.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Good, because I will not permit another unauthorized penny to be taken.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Our credit collections department has applied an administrative hold to prevent debt escalation.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That will keep debt recovery agencies from sending letters to my new cottage.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The ombudsman escalation paperwork will be archived under case identifier CMP-99021-G.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I have filed all those references in my personal records folder.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Our compliance department reviews all disputed early termination collections monthly.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I hope they review this case and realise how unfairly I have been treated.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What was that previous postal address again?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: As I told you during verification, it was 15 Millfield Road, York, YO23 1NQ.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have confirmed the 15 Millfield Road address on your archive record.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Make sure all refund notifications go to my email address.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there any other matter regarding your closed account I can assist you with today, George?
